segments.an8.22:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vajjīsu viharati hatthigāme.
segments.an8.22:1.3: “aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārethā”ti.
segments.an8.22:1.5: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
segments.an8.22:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.an8.22:2.2: Atha kho uggo gahapati hatthigāmako yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ so bhikkhu etadavoca –
segments.an8.22:2.3: “aṭṭhahi kho tvaṃ, gahapati, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato.
segments.an8.22:2.4: Katame te, gahapati, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, yehi tvaṃ samannāgato bhagavatā byākato”ti?
segments.an8.22:3.1: “Na kho ahaṃ, bhante, jānāmi – katamehi aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākatoti.
segments.an8.22:3.3: Api ca, bhante, ye me aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti, taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi;
segments.an8.22:3.5: “Evaṃ, gahapatī”ti kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa paccassosi.
segments.an8.22:3.7: “yadāhaṃ, bhante, nāgavane paricaranto bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ dūratova addasaṃ;
segments.an8.22:3.8: saha dassaneneva me, bhante, bhagavato cittaṃ pasīdi, surāmado ca pahīyi.
segments.an8.22:3.9: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:4.1: “So kho ahaṃ, bhante, pasannacitto bhagavantaṃ payirupāsiṃ.
segments.an8.22:4.2: Tassa me bhagavā anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathesi, seyyathidaṃ – dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ;
segments.an8.22:4.3: kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
segments.an8.22:4.4: Yadā maṃ bhagavā aññāsi kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi – dukkhaṃ, samudayaṃ, nirodhaṃ, maggaṃ.
segments.an8.22:4.6: Seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya;
segments.an8.22:4.7: evamevaṃ kho me tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi –
segments.an8.22:4.9: So kho ahaṃ, bhante, diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane tattheva buddhañca dhammañca saṅghañca saraṇaṃ agamāsiṃ, brahmacariyapañcamāni ca sikkhāpadāni samādiyiṃ.
segments.an8.22:4.10: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:5.1: “Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, catasso komāriyo pajāpatiyo ahesuṃ.
segments.an8.22:5.2: Atha khvāhaṃ, bhante, yena tā pajāpatiyo tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā tā pajāpatiyo etadavacaṃ –
segments.an8.22:5.4: Yā icchati sā idheva bhoge ca bhuñjatu puññāni ca karotu, sakāni vā ñātikulāni gacchatu.
segments.an8.22:5.5: Hoti vā pana purisādhippāyo, kassa vo dammī’ti?
segments.an8.22:5.6: Evaṃ vutte sā, bhante, jeṭṭhā pajāpati maṃ etadavoca –
segments.an8.22:5.8: Atha kho ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ purisaṃ pakkosāpetvā vāmena hatthena pajāpatiṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena bhiṅgāraṃ gahetvā tassa purisassa oṇojesiṃ.
segments.an8.22:5.9: Komāriṃ kho panāhaṃ, bhante, dāraṃ pariccajanto nābhijānāmi cittassa aññathattaṃ.
segments.an8.22:5.10: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:6.1: “Saṃvijjanti kho pana me, bhante, kule bhogā.
segments.an8.22:6.2: Te ca kho appaṭivibhattā sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
segments.an8.22:6.3: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:7.3: So ce me āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti;
segments.an8.22:7.5: No ce me so āyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, ahamassa dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.an8.22:7.6: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, pañcamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:8.1: “Anacchariyaṃ kho pana, bhante, saṅghe nimantite devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti –
segments.an8.22:8.2: ‘asuko, gahapati, bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto asuko paññāvimutto asuko kāyasakkhī asuko diṭṭhippatto [diṭṭhappatto (ka.)] asuko saddhāvimutto asuko dhammānusārī asuko saddhānusārī asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo’ti.
segments.an8.22:8.3: Saṅghaṃ kho panāhaṃ, bhante, parivisanto nābhijānāmi evaṃ cittaṃ uppādento –
segments.an8.22:8.4: ‘imassa vā thokaṃ demi imassa vā bahukan’ti.
segments.an8.22:8.6: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:9.1: “Anacchariyaṃ kho pana maṃ, bhante, devatā upasaṅkamitvā ārocenti –
segments.an8.22:9.3: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, tā devatā evaṃ vademi –
segments.an8.22:9.4: ‘vadeyyātha vā evaṃ kho tumhe devatā no vā vadeyyātha, atha kho svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo’ti.
segments.an8.22:9.5: Na kho panāhaṃ, bhante, abhijānāmi tatonidānaṃ cittassa unnatiṃ –
segments.an8.22:9.6: ‘maṃ tā devatā upasaṅkamanti, ahaṃ vā devatāhi saddhiṃ sallapāmī’ti.
segments.an8.22:9.7: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, sattamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:10.1: “Sace kho panāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato paṭhamataraṃ kālaṃ kareyyaṃ, anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evaṃ byākareyya –
segments.an8.22:10.2: ‘natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyutto uggo gahapati hatthigāmako puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyā’ti.
segments.an8.22:10.3: Ayaṃ kho me, bhante, aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo saṃvijjati.
segments.an8.22:11.1: Ime kho me, bhante, aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā saṃvijjanti.
segments.an8.22:11.2: Na ca kho ahaṃ jānāmi – katamehi cāhaṃ aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato bhagavatā byākato”ti.
segments.an8.22:12.1: “Atha kho so bhikkhu uggassa gahapatino hatthigāmakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
segments.an8.22:12.2: Atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.an8.22:12.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu yāvatako ahosi uggena gahapatinā hatthigāmakena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
segments.an8.22:13.2: Yathā taṃ uggo gahapati hatthigāmako sammā byākaramāno byākareyya, imeheva kho bhikkhu, aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato uggo gahapati hatthigāmako mayā byākato.
segments.an8.22:13.3: Imehi ca pana, bhikkhu, aṭṭhahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ uggaṃ gahapatiṃ hatthigāmakaṃ dhārehī”ti.

lines: Dutiye nāgavaneti tassa kira seṭṭhino nāgavanaṃ nāma uyyānaṃ, so tattha purebhattaṃ gandhamālādīni gāhāpetvā uyyānakīḷikaṃ kīḷitukāmo gantvā paricāriyamāno bhagavantaṃ addasa.
Saha dassanenevassa purimanayeneva cittaṃ pasīdi, surāpānena ca uppannamando taṅkhaṇaṃyeva pahīyi.
Samacittova demīti “imassa thokaṃ, imassa bahukan”ti evaṃ cittanānattaṃ na karomi, deyyadhammaṃ pana ekasadisaṃ karomīti dasseti.
Natthi taṃ saṃyojananti iminā upāsako attano anāgāmiphalaṃ byākaroti.
So hi rājapurisānaṃ hatthato yakkhassa hatthaṃ, yakkhassa hatthato bhagavato hatthaṃ, bhagavato hatthato puna rājapurisānaṃ hatthaṃ gatattā nāmato hatthako āḷavakoti jāto.
Tenāha “āḷavakayakkhassa hatthato hatthehi sampaṭicchitattā hatthakoti laddhanāmo rājakumāro”ti.
